findings.title: BRD-01 propagated diff reverses only the 'analytics dashboards' exclusion; the new per-link-owner authentication requirement (EARS req 3 / ADR-02 authn model) directly contradicts BRD-01's separate 'user accounts and authentication / end-user accounts' exclusion (BRD.01.10.b607), which the §3 BRD-01 diff neither reverses nor addresses — the named BRD-01 update is incomplete for what the change implies, so EARS req 3 lacks a BRD-layer capability anchor.
